question: The Great Indian Novel is written by the famous politician ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shashi Tharoor.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The exceptional Indian Novel is a satirical novel with the aid of Shashi Tharoor, which was first posted through Viking Press in **1989.**
 
• It's far a fictional painting that takes the story of the **Mahabharata.**
 
• The word "notable Indian novel" is an allusion to the long-standing concept of the "exceptional American Novel" and is likewise a pun, more or less translating "Mahabharata" **(maha "exceptional"; Bharata "India").**
